item-seeds-poppy-desc: Tiny oil-rich seeds of the poppy plant. Sow them on farmland to raise a crop of narcotic poppies.
item-seedpod-desc: The dried bulbous capsule of the poppy. Scored and scraped, its latex can be ground down into raw opium.
item-opium-desc: A small pile of brownish-white powder produced by grinding harvested poppy seedpods.
item-morphine-desc: Opium refined with limewater into a pale, bitter powder. A potent painkiller that binds swiftly and leaves the user craving more.
item-morphine-solution-desc: Morphine dissolved in alcohol to form an unstable tincture. Further treatment with spirits coaxes it toward something far stronger.
item-heroin-desc: The final, devastating distillate of the poppy chain. A small taste brings euphoria beyond any other; its grip is absolute and ruinous.
item-coca-leaf-desc: A glossy green leaf chewed for its bitter, numbing vigor. It wards off hunger and fatigue in the high country, at a slow cost.
item-seeds-coca-desc: Hard reddish seeds of the coca shrub. Plant them to grow your own supply of leaves.
item-coca-vitae-desc: A fine white powder made by drying coca paste.
item-coca-paste-desc: A pale beige paste produced by sealing coca leaves with distilled spirits. It dries into Cocaine.
syringe-help: Hold right-click to apply 0.1 L. Right-click an open vessel to refill, or sneak-right-click with a vessel in your off hand. Refill with the same liquid until empty.
item-syringe-empty-desc: Reusable quartz and metal syringe. Holds 1 litre of heroin or morphine solution (10 doses).
vs-dope:addict-greet: A gaunt figure sidles up, eyes darting. "Psst... you got any drugs? I'll pay well."
vs-dope:addict-nodrugs: The addict's face falls. "No drugs? Then what're you wasting my time for." They shamble away.
vs-dope:addict-trade-thanks: "Ha! You're an angel... here, more than we agreed." The addict presses coins into your hands, already eyeing your pack for more.
vs-dope:addict-overdose: The addict's eyes roll back. They crumple to the ground, still clutching their fix.
vs-dope:addict-robbed: The addict snatches what they can from your grip and swings at you before running off!
vs-dope:addict-mugged: "Should've had something for me!" The addict swings wildly and takes off.
addict-leaving: The addict pockets their fix, mumbles something that might be thanks, and shuffles off.
addict-busy-leaving: The addict waves you off. They've got what they came for.
